content.short: FCON DEX is a decentralized trading platform with an AMM built on Mantle.
content.description: The FCON DEX is a decentralized trading platform that uses an automated market maker built on Mantle. It is designed to deliver fixed market rates, high transaction throughput, and low trading fees while maintaining a strong security posture. By combining on-chain liquidity with a focused pricing model, FCON DEX aims to offer traders predictable pricing and fast, cost-efficient trades without relying on centralized intermediaries.
